operations.name: polymarketSearch
operations.description: Search Polymarket events by topic, ranked by total volume by default. Sports, esports, weather, science, entertainment, pop culture and word-mention markets are excluded. Each event lists every outcome market with its question, outcomes, prices, best bid and ask, last trade and spread, plus the event's id, slug, end date, negRisk flag and closed status; volume and liquidity are on the event record. Matching is fuzzy and results can include closed events.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A short topic query, such as fed decision december, us recession 2026 or bitcoin above october 7.

parameters.name: limit_per_type
parameters.description: Number of events to return. Events with dozens of outcomes can exceed the result limit at higher values.

parameters.name: events_tag
parameters.description: Optional category to restrict results to: crypto, finance, economy, geopolitics, tech or politics.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Rank by total volume (default) or liquidity, highest first.

operations.name: polymarketGetEventBySlug
operations.description: Get one event with every market's question, resolution rules (description), prices, bid and ask, volume, liquidity, status, end date, condition ID and outcome IDs. Events with dozens of outcomes can exceed the result limit; open single markets instead.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Event slug from search results or a polymarket.com/event/<slug> link.

operations.name: polymarketGetEventById
operations.description: Get one event by its numeric ID, with the same fields as polymarketGetEventBySlug.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric event ID from search results or a market's events list.

operations.name: polymarketGetMarketBySlug
operations.description: Get one market with its question, resolution rules (description), prices, bid and ask, volume, liquidity, status, end date, price changes, condition ID and outcome IDs.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Market slug from search or event results.

operations.name: polymarketGetMarketById
operations.description: Get one market by its numeric ID, with the same fields as polymarketGetMarketBySlug.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric market ID from event or listing results.

operations.name: polymarketGetTagBySlug
operations.description: Resolve a topic tag, such as bitcoin or fed, to the numeric ID that polymarketListMarketsByTag takes.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Lowercase topic slug, such as bitcoin.

operations.name: polymarketListMarketsByTag
operations.description: List markets under one tag, by total volume by default. Each market includes its event. Tags are broad, so check each market's relevance.

parameters.name: tag_id
parameters.description: A one-item array holding the numeric tag ID from polymarketGetTagBySlug.

parameters.name: closed
parameters.description: Return closed markets instead of open ones.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort field: total volume (default), liquidity or 24-hour volume.

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Sort direction; false lists the highest values first.

parameters.name: after_cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor from a previous response, passed unchanged to get the next page.

operations.name: getRepoContent
operations.description: Read a public directory listing or small UTF-8 text file. Pass a raw path; use '.' for the repository root. File content is decoded text, not base64.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: GitHub account or organization that owns the public repository.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Public repository name without the owner prefix.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Raw file or directory path; the server encodes it. Use '.' for the repository root. Do not percent-encode it.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch name, tag, or commit SHA. Omit to use the repository's default branch.
